**Phone board at 390.** `SCR-05-mobile-cant` passes at `--width 390` with the same thresholds. — verify: same, a row in `scores.txt`.

**Exceptions are limited and explained.** Each entry in `delivery/features/F-48/fidelity-exceptions.json` has `role`, `name`, `category`, `reason`, `approved_by` ("builder proposal, pending design engineer" until signed) and a Conflicts number; F-24's approved entries are carried over unchanged. None covers a value the data can supply. The two phone buttons cite G-SCR05-5. — verify: file content and the build.md mapping.

**Pose by status.** Unit tests: `poseFor` returns `cant` for `cannot_answer`, `working` for `working`, `done` for `drafted`, `idle` for `answered`. The side panel image for CV-2404 is `/agents/zainab-cant.png`; for `answered` it stays `-idle.png`. — verify: `assistant.test.tsx`.

**Side panel text.** For CV-2404 the panel reads "Zainab can't do that with your access.", Project "October payroll" (as the fixture returns), "Your access" "PMO · no payroll access" (as `context.access` returns), and the agents-cannot note. The sentence comes from `status`, not from message text: a fixture whose agent text says "I can't" but has `status: answered` reads the answered sentence. — verify: component tests.

**Thread content.** `/assistant/CV-2404` shows, in order: the ask in the person bubble; "Zainab · HR agent"; the checklist step "Checked your access to payroll records" with "1 STEPS · DONE"; the answer; the `cannot_reason`; one restricted source tag. The list row reads "A staff member's salary" with "Can't share". — verify: component test; page at 1440.

**Reason is text.** A fixture whose `cannot_reason` contains `` and `**bold**` renders those characters literally, creates no element, and is not edited, trimmed of words or joined with `text`. — verify: component test; `grep -rn "dangerouslySetInnerHTML\|innerHTML" frontend/src/features/assistant` is empty.

**No new controls.** On a `cannot_answer` thread there is no draft card, no start button, no "Edit draft", no "Show staff-cost totals", no "Ask HR Lead for access", no request-access link or button, and the composer is empty (not prefilled). No new request is sent by opening or reloading the thread (mock log shows zero POSTs). — verify: component tests; `grep -rn "staff-cost\|Ask HR" frontend/src` is empty; e2e reading `GET /__mock/assistant-log`.

**Restricted source.** The restricted tag shows the lock and "Restricted" only; the fixture's label and reference are not in `document.body.textContent`, and it is not a link. — verify: component test.

**Phone pose card.** At 390, CV-2404 shows the inline pose card with the `zainab-cant.png` image, alt "Zainab, can't do this", in the agent tint. CV-2401 (drafted), CV-2403 (answered) and CV-2405 (working) at 390 show no such card. At 1440 the card is not shown (the side panel carries the pose). — verify: component tests with `useIsPhone` both ways; e2e at 390.

**Reduced motion.** With `reducedMotion: 'reduce'` the `cant` pose has no running animation or transition. — verify: e2e computed-style check.

**build.md evidence.** Commands and results, the 2 scores, every exception with its Conflicts number, the asset source for each `-cant.png`, and the G-SCR05-5 proposal. — verify: file content.

risk.rationale: Low. This is a read-only state on screens F-24 already built, over an existing contract field and an existing fixture. The change is a pose mapping, assets, one phone layout element and tests in `frontend/src/features/assistant/` (SidePanel.tsx, Thread.tsx, ThreadPage.tsx). There is no write, money or migration, and no new authority rule: the restricted payroll content is never in the response, and the screen only shows the backend's refusal. SURFACES is ui only, because the one contract gap (G-SCR05-5) is dropped by exception and not proposed. PRODUCT-ACCEPTANCE is not-required: the work matches the client-approved board, and the left-out phone buttons go to the design engineer as a fidelity difference, as in D-100.
